reasons: Datadog sums the series (sum:redis.clients.blocked) but the candidate uses avg(), so the aggregation is wrong; the PromQL should be sum(...).
The $host template variable (tag prefix host, default *) is dropped; it should become a matcher host=~"$host" on the selector, which the candidate omits.
The $scope variable has no prefix and default *, so dropping it is correct; $key is not referenced by the query and is also correctly absent.
The metric is a non-monotonic sum, so no rate() is needed and the outcome of translated is acceptable once the aggregation and host matcher are fixed.
